title: nse_provider.get_archive_text and _SessionHolder.ensure wait on the process-wide throttle while holding the module _lock, contra the R15-DATA-066 pace-before-lock rule
repro: Static read at 4097dac4: sidecar/services/nse_provider.py:747-749 (with _lock: session = _holder.ensure(); _throttle.wait()) and :259-261 (ensure() calls _throttle.wait() and is itself called under _lock from _get_json:325). A queued archive fetch therefore holds _lock for its whole pacing sleep, blocking every other nse_direct caller. Outside the fix-r1 entries; recorded as an issue, not put in any diff.
